source.qualification: OCR A Level Classical Civilisation H408
source.document: Official specification (The World of the Hero; Culture and the Arts; Beliefs and Ideas)

classics.note: Units follow the specification's components — the Homeric and Virgilian hero, then culture and the arts, then the beliefs and ideas of Greece and Rome.

units.title: The world of the hero: Homer

lesson.title: Homer and the World of the Hero
lesson.summary: The founding epics — Achilles' rage, Odysseus' cunning and how oral poetry works.

units.title: The world of the hero: Virgil

lesson.title: Virgil and the Roman Epic
lesson.summary: Rome's answer to Homer — the Aeneid's politics, piety and literary dialogue.

lesson.title: Greek Theatre: Tragedy and Comedy
lesson.summary: The dramatic inventions of Athens — tragic form, comic politics and the festival stage.

lesson.title: Greek Art and the Parthenon
lesson.summary: The classical eye — sculpture's revolution, the Parthenon programme and painted pottery.

lesson.title: Roman Art and the Imperial Image
lesson.summary: Art as power — imperial portraits, monumental architecture and everyday Roman images.

lesson.title: Greek Religion
lesson.summary: Relating to the gods — ritual, sacrifice and the civic religion of the polis.

units.title: Love, desire and sexuality
topics: Love in Greek poetry and philosophy

lesson.title: Love and Gender in Antiquity
lesson.summary: The ancients on desire — Plato's ladder, Roman elegy and gendered lives.

lesson.title: Athenian Democracy
lesson.summary: The first democracy as a system — institutions, ideology and its ancient critics.

units.title: Reception: the classical tradition
topics: Antiquity in later art and film

lesson.title: The Classical Tradition and Reception
lesson.summary: What the classics mean now — reception from Renaissance to Hollywood and its politics.

source.board: University of Iowa / standard workshop curriculum

creative-writing.note: Units follow the workshop model's arc — craft foundations for prose and poetry, genre workshops, and the professional life of the writer.

units.title: The writer's craft: image and detail

lesson.title: Craft: Image, Detail and the Sentence
lesson.summary: The writer's raw materials — concrete images, telling details and sentence-level control.

lesson.title: Fiction: Story and Structure
lesson.summary: Shaping narrative — scenes versus summary, plot shapes and how stories open and close.

units.title: Fiction II: character and point of view

lesson.title: Character, POV and Dialogue
lesson.summary: Who tells the story and who lives it — viewpoint, voice and speech on the page.

lesson.title: Poetry: Line, Sound and Image
lesson.summary: Poetry's machinery — line breaks, metres and the compression of the lyric image.

units.title: Poetry II: forms and free verse
topics: The prose poem and hybrid forms

lesson.title: Form and Free Verse
lesson.summary: Constraint and liberation — sonnet to sestina, and what free verse still owes to form.

lesson.title: Creative Nonfiction and Memoir
lesson.summary: True stories well told — essay structures, memory's ethics and researched narrative.

units.title: The workshop: reading and revising
topics: How to give and take critique

lesson.title: Workshop and Revision
lesson.summary: Getting better on purpose — workshop protocol, deep revision and reading like a writer.

lesson.title: Publishing and the Writing Life
lesson.summary: From manuscript to readers — submission systems, publishing paths and sustainable practice.

dance.note: Units follow the specification's three strands — performance, choreography and appreciation — each grounded in the anthology of professional set works.

lesson.title: Performance: Technique and Expression
lesson.summary: The dancer's instrument — physical control, expressive qualities and dancing safely.

lesson.title: Choreography: Intent and Craft
lesson.summary: Making dances with purpose — stimuli, motif development and choreographic devices.

lesson.title: Appreciating Dance: the Elements
lesson.summary: A shared language for watching — actions, dynamics, space and relationships.

units.title: The dance anthology: set works
topics: Ballet and other traditions in the anthology

lesson.title: The Anthology: Studying Set Works
lesson.summary: Close study of professional works — how great choreographers solve the craft.

lesson.title: Dance Through History
lesson.summary: How dance got here — from court ballet to contemporary and the vernacular traditions.

lesson.title: Choreographing for the Stage
lesson.summary: From idea to stage — casting, rehearsal craft and the choreographer as leader.

lesson.title: Production, Design and Screendance
lesson.summary: Dance off the studio floor — production design and the camera's choreography.

lesson.title: Critical Writing on Dance
lesson.summary: Dance criticism — arguing about works with evidence, context and the right terms.

source.qualification: Animation industry core-skill framework and canonical texts (Williams, The Animator's Survival Kit)

animation.note: Units follow the industry craft canon — the principles of animation first, then the production pipeline across 2D and 3D, closing with story, direction and the industry.

lesson.title: The Twelve Principles of Animation
lesson.summary: The grammar of the illusion — the Disney-era principles that still govern the craft.

lesson.title: 2D Animation: Keys and Cycles
lesson.summary: Drawing motion — keyframes, inbetweens and the walk cycle every animator masters.

lesson.title: 3D Animation and Rigging
lesson.summary: Animating digital puppets — rigs, curves, mocap and the 3D workflow.

lesson.title: Story and Storyboards
lesson.summary: Animation is storytelling first — boards, beats and testing films before they exist.

lesson.title: Character Design
lesson.summary: Designs that can act — shape language, appeal and building characters that move well.

lesson.title: The Animation Pipeline
lesson.summary: How animated films actually get made — departments, handoffs and bottlenecks.

lesson.title: Animation History and Styles
lesson.summary: A century of the art — Hollywood's golden age, anime, stop-motion and CG's takeover.

lesson.title: Directing and the Animation Industry
lesson.summary: Leading films and careers — the director's role, pitching and the industry map.

lesson.summary: Weather as the pilot's adversary — theory, decoded forecasts and personal minimums.

lesson.title: Performance and Weight & Balance
lesson.summary: The numbers that keep flights safe — density altitude, loading and runway maths.

lesson.title: Navigation and Flight Planning
lesson.summary: Getting there and back — chart work, navigation systems and the airspace puzzle.

lesson.title: Aviation Regulations
lesson.summary: The legal airspace — FARs, currency requirements and where the rules come from.

units.title: Human factors and aeronautical decision making

lesson.title: Human Factors and ADM
lesson.summary: The pilot as failure point — physiology, decision models and managing risk.

lesson.title: Communication and ATC

lesson.title: Foundations of Instrument Flight
lesson.summary: Flying without the horizon — instrument interpretation and the road to the IFR rating.

lesson.title: Stocks, Sauces and Soups

lesson.title: Proteins: Butchery and Cookery
lesson.summary: Handling proteins well — cuts, cooking to doneness and responsible sourcing.

lesson.title: Vegetables, Grains and Starches
lesson.summary: The rest of the plate — vegetable cookery, grains and the science of starch.

lesson.title: Flavour, Menus and Presentation

lesson.title: Collections: Building and Curating
lesson.summary: Curating access — development policies, budgets and the digital shift.

units.title: Information ethics, access and technology
